visual_evaluation.evaluator_identity: Codex (GPT-6), same session as builder; unblinded self-review
visual_evaluation.method: Direct visual inspection of all six Workbench PNGs; technical reports reviewed separately.

scale.1: Requirement absent or major visual problems

proportions.notes: Seat and leg proportions read clearly as a compact stool. Dimensions are separately validated, not inferred from the render.

silhouette.notes: Four gently splayed, tapered legs give a recognizable, symmetric stool silhouette; opposing legs overlap in cardinal projections.

structural_plausibility.notes: Legs visibly meet the seat and share a ground level. No joinery or bracing is shown. Appearance and AABB support checks do not prove strength or stability.

surface_cleanliness.notes: No obvious holes or detached pieces. Cylindrical faceting and uneven highlight bands remain visible. Edge rounding is subtle, especially under nonuniform object scale.

material_plausibility.notes: Uniform grey diagnostic shading has no wood appearance. Material assignment fails because the public material tools are scheduled for Milestone 13.

limitations: Self-review, not independent or blind evaluation.
Workbench lighting does not evaluate wood shaders.
Physical stability and exact surface contact are not certified.
